verdict_reasoning: The CEX/INFRA reclassification was applied deterministically and non-destructively to the full 385-family corpus. 13 of 21 (61.9%) originally-STRONG candidates were correctly downgraded to NON_ATTRIBUTIVE_PROVENANCE. In the process of the Watchtower control check, this reconciliation ALSO caught and corrected a real methodological error from earlier this session: the claimed '5 canonical Watchtower matches' were actually CANDIDATE-state, not CONFIRMED -- and one of those candidate rows (is6MTRHEgy..., OKX Hot Wallet) is itself a genuine false-positive already sitting in Watchtower's own review queue, independent of the new discovery pipeline. The 575-member '56-launch family' is now understood to be rooted at a Binance CEX wallet and should be reclassified as ordinary exchange activity, not a candidate operation, pending re-review of the original smaller OF-P0 subset.
